candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot aggregate, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.aggregate_snapshot: July BDUK values are rounded management-information fields limited to initial contract scope; contracted-minus-built arithmetic is not a parcel backlog, completion forecast or contractual milestone assessment.
scope_guards.derived_snapshot: Shares and medians are deterministic calculations over the displayed rounded July table and total; they are not official statistics or exact-address availability evidence.
scope_guards.supplier_aggregate: Supplier totals and contract shares aggregate displayed rounded rows with the same supplier label; they do not establish corporate delivery performance, contractual compliance or address-level service.
scope_guards.supplier_rank: Within-supplier ranks use displayed rounded values and competition ranking; ties and rounding limit interpretation and the ranking is not an official performance table.
scope_guards.median_metric: Median differences describe the displayed July table only and do not measure delivery quality, delay, need, geography or parcel-level status.
scope_guards.coverage_scope: Connected Nations figures are national aggregate coverage and take-up estimates with stated methodologies; they do not guarantee availability, speed or service at a specific address.
scope_guards.mobile_prediction_scope: Mobile coverage figures rely on operator signal-strength predictions and confidence thresholds; actual device, indoor, time-specific and local performance may differ.
scope_guards.checker_scope: Checker outputs are estimates and categories, not current outage information or a guarantee that a provider will sell service at a particular premises.
scope_guards.checker_limit_scope: Checker base data, network submissions and predictive models have update and coverage limits; absence or presence of a prediction is not definitive service availability.
scope_guards.emergency_scope: Emergency-call compliance information summarises regulatory obligations and a closed programme; it is not legal advice or proof of a particular call or provider outcome.
